# Hoover Treated Wood Products

> > Hoover Treated Wood Products specializes in fire-retardant-treated wood (FRTW) and pressure-treated lumber, including PyroGuard interior FRTW, CCA-treated wood, and architectural solutions for code-compliant construction.

The company provides comprehensive fire-retardant and preservative wood treatment solutions with a focus on building code compliance, particularly for IBC, NFPA, and state-specific regulations. Hoover serves architects, builders, and contractors with products like PyroGuard, Clear-Guard, and Pyro-Guard backing board, along with technical support and educational resources.

## Key Topics

- Fire-Retardant-Treated Wood (FRTW)
- PyroGuard interior FRTW
- Building code compliance (IBC, NFPA)
- Pressure-treated wood
- Fire safety standards
- CCA wood preservative
- NFPA 285 compliance
- UL certifications
- Minnesota Building Code
- Wood treatment processes
- Clear-Guard preservative
- Pyro-Guard backing board
- Architectural fire safety
- Code enforcement best practices

## Core FRTW Products

- [PyroGuard - Interior Fire Retardant Treated Wood](https://frtw.com/products/pyroguard): PyroGuard interior FRTW with UL certification and IBC compliance
- [PyroGuard Specifications/Technical Notes](https://frtw.com/pyro-guard-specifications-technical-notes): PyroGuard technical specs, UL certifications, and NFPA 285 compliance
- [Pyro-Guard Backing Board](https://frtw.com/pyro-guard-backing-board): Pyro-Guard fire retardant backing board for steel stud installations
- [Discover the Benefits of Fire-Retardant-Treated Wood (FRTW)](https://frtw.com/discover-the-benefits-of-fire-retardant-treated-wood-frtw): Overview of FRTW benefits and pressure treatment process

## Wood Preservative Products

- [CCA](https://frtw.com/cca): CCA pressure-treated wood with KDAT for decay and termite protection
- [Clear-Guard](https://frtw.com/cop8): Clear-Guard permethrin-based wood preservative for decay protection

## Code Compliance & Best Practices

- [5 Best Practices for FRTW Code Enforcement & Compliance](https://frtw.com/5-best-practices-for-frtw-code-enforcement-compliance): Five best practices for FRTW code enforcement compliance
- [Best Practice in Fire-Retardant-Treated Wood Code Enforcement](https://frtw.com/best-practice-in-fire-retardant-treated-wood-code-enforcement): Best practices for FRTW code enforcement and building standards
- [Demystifying Fire-Retardant-Treated Wood Specifications](https://frtw.com/demystifying-fire-retardant-treated-wood-specifications): Guide to understanding FRTW specifications and building codes
- [Fire-Retardant-Treated Wood and the Minnesota Building Code](https://frtw.com/fire-retardant-treated-wood-and-the-minnesota-building-code): FRTW compliance with Minnesota Building Code requirements
- [NFPA Code Provisions and Fire Retardant Treated Wood](https://frtw.com/nfpa-code-provisions-and-fire-retardant-treated-wood): NFPA code provisions for fire retardant treated wood applications
